DM YOUR CODEBASE

CodeDM connects WhatsApp, Instagram and Telegram to coding agents running on this Mac — DM your codebase like it's any other chat. Nothing leaves your machine.

Download Read the docs

HOW IT WORKS

01

Channels become terminal agents

Pair WhatsApp, Instagram or Telegram once. Every message routes straight to a coding agent running in a terminal session on your Mac — Claude Code, Codex, whichever you point it at.

02

Issues, written from a message

"The coupon field is broken on mobile" gets classified into a tracked issue, scoped to a workspace folder, and handed to an agent. No board, no ticket forms — just the chat you already sent.

03

Human-in-the-loop stops

Agents pause and ping you the moment they need a call. Open the session, decide, resume — or leave a thread autonomous so replies ship without review. You stay in control of every merge.

04

Local-first, always

No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Agents run against project folders on your own machine and everything — messages, sessions, artifacts — stays local. Open source, MIT licensed.

PUT YOUR CONTACTS TO WORK

Connect a channel, point at a project folder, attach a thread. Your first coding agent is three steps away.
